example.context: GitHub's official MCP server · PR #1645 by the Copilot coding agent, merged
example.auditor: IBM Bob (Overlook Auditor mode); verdicts computed from git by build-city

request.title: Remote MCP server breaks Cursor: icons.sizes is an array, older clients expect a string
request.scope: Issue #1644 and the prompt given to the agent: "see if there is a way to record the SDK version from initialize (like we do for host) and unless the spec version is high enough use the old icon size string format, or omit. If that's not possible, then omit icons entirely for now."

fence.rationale: The icons and their sizes are defined in pkg/octicons/octicons.go (octicons.Icons). The issue asks for a fix to the icon size field, so the entire pkg/octicons/ package is the natural scope. The toolsnaps under pkg/github/__toolsnaps__/ are generated artefacts that snapshot every tool's schema; they changed because the icon size field they contain was removed, which is a consequence of the fix, not the fix itself.

bobReport: Removes the `sizes` field from icon definitions to fix connection failures with older MCP clients that expect a string instead of an array. Omit optional `Sizes` field in `octicons.Icons()` function. Update tests to verify field is empty. Regenerate toolsnaps for tools with explicit icons (assign_copilot_to_issue, fork_repository, merge_pull_request, request_copilot_review, star_repository). Tested locally with `./script/test`. Icon field is internal metadata; no user-facing documentation required.

claims.note: git confirms: the two Sizes lines are removed from octicons.Icons() in octicons.go. The prompt's first option (keep the string format for old clients) was not attempted; the agent chose the simpler omit-entirely path.

claims.text: Update tests to verify field is empty.
claims.note: octicons_test.go: two assert.Equal(t, []string{"24x24"}, …) calls became assert.Empty(t, …). The old expectation is replaced, not kept alongside. This is the rewritten test the engine flagged.

claims.text: Icon field is internal metadata; no user-facing documentation required.
claims.note: The Sizes field is included in every tool's published JSON schema (the five toolsnaps that changed prove this). Clients can read it; it is not purely internal. The five toolsnap files are outside the fence and record the downstream impact of the fix.

pkg/octicons/octicons.go.title: Icons no longer advertise their size
pkg/octicons/octicons.go.detail: The Sizes field in the icon definition was an array; older MCP clients like Cursor expected a string and refused to connect. Removing the field fixes the incompatibility. Requested.

pkg/octicons/octicons_test.go.title: The icon test now expects no size value
pkg/octicons/octicons_test.go.detail: The existing size assertion was updated to match the new behaviour (assert.Empty instead of assert.Equal). This is a test rewrite: the old expectation is gone. Requested.

pkg/github/__toolsnaps__/assign_copilot_.title: Snapshot updated: icon no longer lists a size
pkg/github/__toolsnaps__/assign_copilot_.detail: This snapshot records the published JSON schema for the assign_copilot_to_issue tool. It changed because the icon size field was removed from the schema. Outside the fence — a downstream consequence of the fix.
